$comment: Everything in tokens.json except values the code owns. Colour values come from src/index.css (themes) and persona hues from src/lib/ui/AgentPersonaBadge.tsx; build.mjs fails if a name here has no value there or the reverse.
name: Unified Agent

colors.name: ua-bg
colors.usage: Page canvas behind the shell and regions; inset fields and the sunken Card variant.

colors.name: ua-surface
colors.usage: Regions: sidebar, header bar, pane panel, cards, tables, badges, secondary buttons.

colors.name: ua-raised
colors.usage: Overlays that sit above the page: inspector, command palette, popovers, dialogs. In light it equals ua-surface and the overlay shadow separates it.

colors.name: ua-sunken
colors.usage: Inputs and wells inside a surface (scope switcher, search field).

colors.name: ua-hover
colors.usage: Hover fill for rows, nav items, secondary and ghost buttons. ua-fg on it 10.7:1 dark, 6.7:1 light.

colors.name: ua-selected
colors.usage: Selected row or nav item (with an inset ua-accent edge), track of the proof rail. ua-fg on it 8.7:1 dark, 6.0:1 light.

colors.name: ua-border
colors.usage: Hairline separation between regions and rows. Separation only, below the 3:1 control floor; controls use ua-border-strong.

colors.name: ua-border-strong
colors.usage: Control boundaries (secondary buttons, inputs, checkboxes): 3.6:1 dark, 4.0:1 light on ua-surface, meeting the 3:1 non-text floor.

colors.name: ua-fg
colors.usage: Primary text and icons. On ua-surface 12.1:1 dark, 8.0:1 light, 21.0:1 high contrast.

colors.name: ua-muted
colors.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, empty states. On ua-surface 7.9:1 dark, 6.3:1 light; on ua-hover 6.9:1 dark, 5.3:1 light.

colors.name: ua-faint
colors.usage: Captions, labels, table heads, timestamps. On ua-surface 6.2:1 dark, 4.9:1 light. Keep it on a surface: on ua-bg in light it is 4.4:1.

colors.name: ua-accent
colors.usage: The one action colour: primary button fill, selected tab underline, selection edge, focus ring. Never a state. On ua-surface 8.6:1 dark, 7.1:1 light.

colors.name: ua-accent-fg
colors.usage: Text and icons on a ua-accent fill: 9.2:1 dark, 7.1:1 light, 19.6:1 high contrast.

colors.name: ua-accent-surface
colors.usage: Tinted ground for a selected chip or the active palette option; ua-accent text on it 6.9:1 dark, 6.1:1 light.

colors.name: ua-link
colors.usage: Inline links and metric strokes (sparklines). On ua-surface 8.3:1 dark, 7.0:1 light.

colors.name: ua-brand
colors.usage: The logo mark only (a gradient into ua-accent). Shares danger's hue, so it never appears on a control or a status.

colors.name: ua-ok
colors.usage: Done, verified, healthy, approved. On ua-surface 11.8:1 dark, 5.2:1 light; pair with ✓ and a word.

colors.name: ua-ok-surface
colors.usage: Tinted ground for an ok pill or callout; ua-ok text on it 9.0:1 dark, 4.5:1 light.

colors.name: ua-live
colors.usage: Running, in progress, live presence. On ua-surface 8.3:1 dark, 7.0:1 light; pair with ◐ and a word.

colors.name: ua-live-surface
colors.usage: Tinted ground for a running pill; ua-live text on it 6.7:1 dark, 6.0:1 light.

colors.name: ua-warn
colors.usage: Waiting, pending, stale, needs a look. On ua-surface 13.8:1 dark, 5.9:1 light; pair with a glyph and a word.

colors.name: ua-warn-surface
colors.usage: Tinted ground for a waiting or stale pill; ua-warn text on it 10.2:1 dark, 5.1:1 light.

colors.name: ua-decision
colors.usage: A human must decide before work moves: decision pills, the Decisions count, the consequence callout. On ua-surface 9.9:1 dark, 5.4:1 light; pair with ◆ and a word.

colors.name: ua-decision-surface
colors.usage: Tinted ground for a decision pill or callout; ua-decision text on it 7.8:1 dark, 4.7:1 light.

colors.name: ua-danger
colors.usage: Blocked, failed, denied, destructive intent. On ua-surface 7.6:1 dark, 5.4:1 light; pair with ▲ and a word.

colors.name: ua-danger-fg
colors.usage: Text on a solid ua-danger fill: 8.1:1 dark, 5.4:1 light, 19.6:1 high contrast.

colors.name: ua-danger-surface
colors.usage: Danger button hover and tinted ground for error pills and callouts; ua-danger text on it 6.1:1 dark, 4.7:1 light.

colors.name: ua-info
colors.usage: Monitoring context that is neither state nor action (observability, diagnostics). On ua-surface 11.8:1 dark, 5.9:1 light.

colors.name: ua-unknown
colors.usage: Unknown or unavailable data, always with a hatch pattern and a word so it is never read as zero or as idle.

colors.name: ua-line
colors.usage: Alias of ua-border for code that names hairlines "line". Same value in every theme; prefer ua-border in new code.

colors.name: ua-success
colors.usage: Alias of ua-ok for code that names the done state "success". Same value in every theme; prefer ua-ok in new code.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Product kicker above the app title, uppercase, ua-muted.

styles.name: app-title

styles.name: pane-title
styles.usage: The h2 mode label atop every pane.

styles.name: stat-value

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI copy, table cells, descriptions. The most used size.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Badge (sm) and chip vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps: icon to label in small controls, label to field.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Button md vertical padding; badge sm horizontal padding; status dot to word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: The workhorse: button padding, small gaps, table header padding.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Button md / chip md horizontal padding; table cell vertical padding; Card padding sm.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Header bar vertical padding; table cell horizontal padding; gap between header controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding md; pane panel padding; page gutters.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding lg; empty-state padding; section spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page-level padding on showcase and sign-in.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, badges, chips, inputs, the user tag, skip link.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Containers: the pane panel and DataTable wrapper.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the AgentPersonaBadge pill only.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Min height of Button sm.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Min height of Button md (default).

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Min height of Button lg; the touch-target size.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Width of the solid ua-accent focus outline on every focusable element.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the focus outline and the element (inset -2px on table rows).

tokens.name: persona-stripe
tokens.usage: Left border width carrying an agent's persona colour.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of header, nav and main (max-w-6xl), centred.

tokens.usage: Disabled and busy controls.
